name: Upsurge Seeds of Agriculture Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2017, Upsurge Seeds of Agriculture Ltd is enagaged in agricultural activites of production of seeds on lease 
hold land[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
USAL is an ISO 9001:2015 manufacturer, importer, exporter and supplier of Agriculture Seeds and develops 75 varieties of Crops. 
It sells its seeds under the brand name USA seeds. Company is having Seed license from Gujarat, Maharashtra and Rajasthan

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 108% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 2.58 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
